posts.author: Tradebywicks
posts.text: Path Of Success For Traders — Every candle has a meaning, candle body and its wicks, and candle location in chart makes the candle’s way of working. To be a trader it is not important to read hundreds of charts and get the headache. You just need to read the charts where there is liquidty. You can study Gold or BTC chart and just try to understand a certain portion of chart, not the whole chart, give attatention to that part and try to understand the logic behind it. Just focus on candle wicks and analyse the candles and check yours performance after 15 days.

posts.author: Ranjit_DailyTrader
posts.text: Path Of Success For Traders — Chart reading is important, but demand and supply zones alone don’t guarantee success. Wicks can show price rejection, but they don’t always tell us why the price moved. Risk management, discipline, and proper backtesting matter just as much. The real skill is learning which setups actually work over time, not just finding zones on a chart.
